commit_message:
[Merged] Fix a potential buffer overflow in the ICU upper() function.

FossilOrigin-Name: b8dc1b9f5d413000387bfe784b69f5d0ee5c0489
pr_title: Handle expanding ICU case conversions with 64-bit buffer sizes
pr_description: Resize the ICU upper() and lower() output buffer when case conversion requires additional space. Track output byte counts with sqlite3_int64, calculate UTF-16 byte lengths using 64-bit multiplication, and allocate through sqlite3_realloc64().

intro_commit_message:
Fix a potential buffer overflow in the ICU upper() function.

FossilOrigin-Name: b8dc1b9f5d413000387bfe784b69f5d0ee5c0489
fix_commit_message:
Prevent integer overflow in the ICU extension. [bugs:/forumpost/844bdd7d5c|Bug report 844bdd7d5c].

FossilOrigin-Name: c20cb75ca07d0553d7a847c65a40efb2e5c587579ec32b02121a8963c70db12f
agent_reasoning: The original implementation used signed 32-bit multiplication for ICU output byte counts and passed those counts to sqlite3_realloc(), which accepts an int. Large conversion results could overflow and produce an incorrect allocation size. The source edits use sqlite3_int64 for nOut, 2LL for both conversion length multiplications, and sqlite3_realloc64() to preserve the allocation size. Only ext/icu/icu.c was edited; test files and Fossil metadata were left untouched. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
